SIDE-PROFILE MID-STRIDE — camera 90-degrees to squad sprinting left-to-right through frame, all four troopers frozen mid-stride at different stride-phases, weapons leveled forward, motion-blur streaking ruined cityscape behind them, power-armor servos visible mid-cycle.

ROOFTOP-DOWN COMBAT — high-angle camera from rooftop ledge looking down at squad clearing courtyard, lead trooper mid-execute over fallen enemy at frame-center, brass scattered across pavement, two others covering perimeter corners, kill-trail of bodies marking entry path.

THROUGH-SMOKE EMERGE — camera at midground level as squad emerges through dense smoke wall firing weapons, lead trooper resolving from silhouette into armored form mid-mag-dump, second and third still emerging with muzzle-flashes blazing through unresolved smoke.

BEHIND-LEAD MID-BREACH — camera positioned directly behind lead trooper as they enter the room weapon-up firing, second and third troopers flanking through doorway behind, room-interior lit entirely by consecutive muzzle-flashes, ceiling shrapnel falling, targets dropping at frame-edges.

DUTCH-ANGLE FIREFIGHT — frame tilted 20-degrees, squad mid-firefight with structural debris raining from above, lead trooper firing heavy bolter mid-burst at frame-left, second mid-grenade-throw at frame-right, muzzle-flashes strobing upward from below, pure controlled chaos reading.

HERO-SHOT LOW-3/4 BACKLIT — entire squad backlit by massive munitions explosion behind them, low 3/4 angle with all weapons raised mid-aim, edge-lit white-hot in silhouette, smoke and burning embers visible in foreground, slow-motion key-art energy throughout.

LEAD-TROOPER-FILL-FRAME — extreme close on lead trooper's snarling cracked visor and weapon mid-blast, blood and soot across helmet-face, squad members in defocused background mid-firefight, the lead trooper's kill-locked aggression filling every centimeter of frame.

VEHICLE-DISMOUNT FROM ABOVE — overhead 3/4 camera above dropship ramp as squad mid-leaps to ground simultaneously, ramp visible at frame-top, weapons raised mid-jump, impact-dust kicking up below each trooper, objective-structure smoking at frame-bottom already engaged.

EXECUTE-OVER-KNEEL — lead trooper's weapon pressed to kneeling enemy's skull, trigger-pull moment frozen, two squad members covering perimeter weapons-outward at frame-edges, blood-pool already spreading at kneeling enemy's feet, third trooper advancing background threat.

MID-CHARGE WIDE-DRONE — high-altitude drone shot of squad mid-charge across open rubble-field toward fortified position at deep-frame distance, brass and bodies marking their advance behind, dust-trail rising, enemy hardpoint smoking and falling ahead of them.

THROUGH-DEBRIS-BURST — camera at squad-level as they burst through collapsing wall, concrete chunks mid-fall around them, lead trooper mid-stride weapons-up emerging through dust, backlight catching debris-cloud edge, second and third troopers mid-breach behind.

EXTREME-CLOSE PAULDRON — extreme close-up on a heavily weathered power-armor pauldron with hand-scratched kill-tally marks past 70-count, other squad members in soft-focused background mid-firefight, pauldron detail dominating composition while kill-energy burns behind.

MID-EXECUTE FOREGROUND — lead trooper's weapon pressed to enemy temple in tight foreground, trigger-pull caught, other squad members mid-distance covering perimeter weapons-raised, blood-pool spreading at foot of frame, kill-confirmed dominance reading throughout composition.

NIGHT-MUZZLE-FLASH-STROBE — deep-night combat, squad lit only by own muzzle-flashes firing through darkness, lead trooper's mag-dump throwing white-hot light across frame-center, others visible only by their own intermittent flash-silhouettes, darkness reclaiming between bursts.

LOW-ANGLE STAIRWELL ASCENT — camera at bottom of stairwell looking up as squad charges upward toward camera, lead trooper's armored boots mid-step above lens, weapon firing upward, two troopers behind on lower steps mid-ascent weapons-raised, confined aggression maximized.

BREACH-CHARGE DETONATION PUSH — camera at corridor-level as shaped charge detonates the door outward, lead trooper pushing through the blast-front mid-step weapon-leveled, debris and door-shrapnel filling frame around them, squad stacked behind surging through the kill-corridor.

SUPPRESSION-FIRE CROUCH-TO-ADVANCE — camera at ground-level beside lead trooper as they rise from cover weapon-firing mid-burst, two squad members at frame-edges maintaining suppression fire, muzzle-flashes lighting faces from below, third trooper already mid-sprint advancing behind.

OVERHEAD STAIRWELL SPIRAL — camera from above looking straight down as squad spirals upward through stairwell in tight formation, weapons pointed outward, lead trooper visible at top mid-fire, others ascending below in compressed kill-team formation, spent brass falling downward.

CLOSE-QUARTERS MELEE PUSH — camera at chest-height, lead trooper mid-strike driving armored fist through close-quarters obstacle, second trooper firing past lead's shoulder, third advancing from frame-left, motion-blur on strike-arm, impact-debris radiating outward from point of contact.
